last_result.headline: N7 closed: tortuosity does not predict our honest line error at either granularity. Well-level CV R^2 0.0292 vs the 0.0736 bar; row-level pooled spearman -0.0416 with the within-well relationship flipping sign between wells (mean -0.083, std 0.371, |rho|>0.2 in 60.8%). The smoke caught a real defect first: at the native 1ft XYZ grid, angles measure coordinate quantization (dls_mean ~49.7 deg/100ft, impossible) - fixed by resampling to 30ft survey stations, after which values are sane and stable across spacing. Paper unretrievable (ScienceDirect 403) so a FAMILY of measures was implemented from the abstract principles, making the conclusion independent of the exact formula.
